scoring_justification: The checker compares the agent's SHG efficiency spectrum to a hidden reference spectrum (Gaussian fit to the paper's nominal geometry simulation). A direct re‑run of the RCWA computation from the raw artifact is infeasible without the solver, but the reference is a trustworthy gold.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference parameters for the nominal MIM geometry's SHG efficiency spectrum (peak wavelength, peak value, Gaussian sigma).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 1(c) (computed efficiency), with peak efficiency 8×10⁻9 W⁻¹ at 3.17 µm; the Gaussian fits the shape of the simulated spectrum shown in the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Gaussian curve matching the paper's reported peak and approximate width from Fig. 1(c); the reference is a smooth fit to the expected spectrum, not a pixel‑level extraction.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The parameters reproduce the paper's key computational result within accepted tolerance; an agent's correct RCWA‑generated spectrum will have the same peak and high correlation with this reference.

outputs.description: SHG efficiency spectrum computed for the nominal MIM grating over pump wavelengths 2.9–3.3 µm.

output_contract.notes: Spectrum must cover pump wavelengths from 2.9 µm to 3.3 µm in steps ≤0.01 µm. The structure and material parameters are fixed: d=544 nm, w=235 nm, t=40 nm, h=152 nm, Au Drude (λp=159 nm, γ=0.0075), GaAs n=3.3, χ^(2)_xyz=150 pm/V. Pump TM-polarized normal incidence; signal TE-polarized at λ/2.

steps.description: Agent's peak pump wavelength is within ±0.02 µm of the reference peak (3.17 µm).
Agent's peak SHG efficiency is within ±10% of the reference peak (8.0×10⁻⁹ W⁻¹).
Pearson correlation between the agent's spectrum and the reference Gaussian spectrum exceeds 0.98.
